key_insight: GDSW-type coarse spaces enable scalable high-order 3D Schwarz preconditioning, but VEM requires moment-correct representations of the operator kernel to retain coarse-level effectiveness for k ≥ 3.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners support parallel finite element and virtual element simulations of Poisson and linear elasticity problems.
method: Study two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW, GDSW*, and reduced GDSW coarse spaces.
Represent operator-kernel interface values through face moments for high-order 3D VEM.
Evaluate FEM on hexahedral meshes and VEM on hexahedral and polyhedral meshes.
evidence_signal: Tests reach polynomial degree k = 5 and 4,096 subdomains and parallel cores, showing scalable Poisson iteration counts across all coarse-space variants and extension of the moment-based construction to linear elasticity.
watch_item: The VEM coarse-space construction is not purely algebraic: omitting the face-moment correction makes the coarse level ineffective for k ≥ 3.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 3D
